chooseCompanion: Choose a target fund for the companion, or select Normal.
unmatchedCompanion: Saved anchor: {fund}, not a plan target now
notInPlanHint: Counts toward the rebalance total, but receives no buys. A zero target can suggest a full exit on Sell; CSPX stays Keep.
outsideHint: Outside the rebalance total; no buys or sells suggested.
companionHint: Counts toward its anchor’s strategy sleeve while that sleeve is in the plan. If the sleeve is not in the plan, this holding stays outside the rebalance.
removePlanConfirm: This fund is in your plan ({portfolio}). Removing it counts it as not held, so the Buy step will still include it. To drop it from the plan, edit the portfolio.
